title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1221: There’s always someone better (2)

section.p: A chill crept up the spines of everyone in the area. Countless incarnations of Lan Tian had appeared in the sky. Every one of them seemed like the true Lan Tian. They talked among themselves, each with a completely different expression, and each with a completely different personality.
Even the dragon was discomfited by the sight of this. He said, “You’re crazy. Are all these puppets? How many myriad race experts have you killed to create so many puppets?”

Every single Lan Tian present was a real, unique individual. Or to be precise, these were all the people who had been killed by Lan Tian. Nobody knew that Lan Tian had actually killed so many experts. There were hundreds of them, and each of them seemed like the real Lan Tian.

Nobody knew which of them was the real Lan Tian. Suddenly, all the Lan Tians paused before speaking the exact same words in perfect harmony, “I am myself. I am Lan Tian. I walk the path of myriad race fusion. Everyone pursues the path of three body fusion. But that won’t encourage the unity of the myriad races. Only by fusing the myriad races can we achieve true unity. Only then can we achieve true peace. I shall affirm my dao with the bodies of the myriad races! Instead of three bodies, I will affirm my dao with ten thousand bodies!”
Even the Pseudo Invincibles felt their hearts palpitating upon hearing that declaration. What an absolute madman.
That was no empty declaration.
This lunatic was truly trying to do that.

The immortal Pseudo Invincible said, “Watch out. This guy is already mad. Every one of them is a real body. He has cut his sea of willpower into countless pieces before embedding them into each of these bodies, making all of them real bodies. All of them are him.”
“Baddie, why are you saying such unpleasant things about me?”
“Be careful!”
The immortal Pseudo Invincible warned, “He—cough, cough…”

Before the immortal could finish his warning, the First Divine Sect master detonated a character and blasted the immortal to the point of coughing blood. The First Divine Sect master coldly asked, “Why are you not paying attention when you’re fighting me?”
But even the First Divine Sect master couldn’t help but stare at Lan Tian. He had known Lan Tian for many years, and he knew that Lan Tian wasn’t normal.
However, he had never expected that Lan Tian would be such a madman.
Hundreds of Lan Tians attacked together, raining all sorts of attacks from the sky. Devils, divines, dragons, demons…
The abilities of numerous races were used as he attacked.
Everyone else was alarmed. Was this the dao Lan Tian walked?
Fusing the myriad races?
This lunatic might have really walked upon a completely new dao.

Some Lan Tians were blasted apart, but some Lan Tians managed to land their attacks on the dragon. After looking at each other, Administrator Hu and General Zhao decided to withdraw. This madman was too scary. They weren’t sure if the madman would include even them in his attacks.
One of the Lan Tians flashed a seductive smile and said, “Why are you leaving? Let’s have some fun together.”
Madman!
Even Su Yu couldn’t resist cursing inwardly.
And Lan Tian was not the only one who was mad. Even his subordinates were all mad.

Over a thousand of his fanatical believers were throwing themselves toward the Sunmoons without regard for their lives. Blood and flesh filled the battlefield. Without fail, every single believer would yell the same words before dying, “Holy Sect, bringer of peace!”

The fanatical manner in which they were throwing their lives away was even scarier than the valiant sacrifice of the Martial Dragon Guard. In fact, even some of the Sunmoons were starting to feel alarmed even when they were the ones doing the killing without suffering any harm.
However, there was also no doubt that Lan Tian’s arrival had further lightened the burden on the humans.
More and more people died in the battle.

As for Su Yu, he was starting to grow reckless. Initially, he would find an excuse for every human he helped. But now, people were starting to flee from him whenever they saw him approaching. They were simply too wary of him.

When Su Yu noticed Titanic Strength and the others running away from him, he coldly asked, “Why are you looking at me like that? Just because First Profound is a traitor does not mean I’m a traitor as well. If you must suspect someone, you should suspect the Profound Department head instead. It’s not like I have access to First Profound’s information.”
The pavilion elders didn’t even know what to believe anymore.
What was this?

The Heavenly Hunt Pavilion had deployed a powerful force to the Human Realm, but the eighth elder had been slain while First Profound was Nan Wujiang all along. They were starting to waver, unsure of what they should do.
Meanwhile, the ruin was slowly emerging.
Lan Tian’s arrival was helpful, but humanity was still under a lot of pressure.
Zhu Tiandao, who was still busy fighting, looked around and cursed helplessly.
That traitor was way too patient.
The dao affirmations in the Allheaven Battlefield had yet to start.

Great Qin King intended to start only after three Invincibles appeared. And it was unlikely for the stubborn Great Qin King to change his mind. What should they do now? Where could they find another expert to force a third Invincible to appear?
“Wan Tiansheng…”

Zhu Tiandao cursed. Had Wan Tiansheng done a better job at hiding than him? He felt like he should be the real trump card here, not Wan Tiansheng. But the damn Wan Tiansheng was still happily hiding away. Was he not aware that almost everyone knew he was hiding his strength?

Zhu Tiandao kept cursing inwardly. Wan Tiansheng was clearly trying to force him to reveal himself first. He was greatly displeased about this. Wouldn’t that be an acknowledgment from him that Wan Tiansheng was better?
In his fury, he shouted at the Pseudo Invincible he was fighting, “Why are you still fighting me? Are you really tired of living?”
“Hahaha!”
The nether Pseudo Invincible laughed with amusement. Him? Tired of living? Zhu Tiandao should worry about his own afterlife instead.
The laughter further infuriated Zhu Tiandao.

He clenched his teeth in annoyance. He had believed that he was very patient. But a certain old turtle was a lot more patient than him. Just look at how that damn bastard was still patiently hiding in the shadows. First Divine, Lan Tian, First Profound, Xia Xiao’er…all those people had been exposed.
The Xia Family was indeed terrifyingly powerful. And this was still not enough for that bastard to reveal himself.

Fine, fine. Zhu Tiandao reached a decision. He would be the one to lure the third Invincible. With a snort, a massive tower disappeared in the faraway Great Ming before suddenly reappearing on the battlefield.
Hundred Dao Pagoda!
Zhu Tiandao stepped into the tower before anyone could react. Then, he casually tore space apart to reveal a tiny River of Time. A second Zhu Tiandao walked out and held the tower in his hand.

That alarmed the Pseudo Invincible he was facing. The Pseudo Invincible was just about to flee when he found his past body forcefully dragged out of him. The body reappeared in Zhu Tiandao’s hand before it was crushed.
Wielding the tower with one hand, Zhu Tiandao slammed it down. The nether Pseudo Invincible roared desperately as he attempted to flee. Alas, it was too late.
A bright explosion erupted, followed by the appearance of a dropping moon.
A Pseudo Invincible had died before anyone could react.
This was the sixth Pseudo Invincible to die today.
Silence descended as everyone tried to process the latest death. One of the remaining Pseudo Invincibles howled madly, “Damn it! Zhu Tiandao! You…”
At the same time, the Pseudo Invincible who was locked in a battle with Qin Hao hurriedly made his escape.
That was a Pseudo Invincible from the goldsteel lion race. He was feeling greatly alarmed.

Of the three number twos, Xia Xiao’er had revealed his strength as a Pseudo Invincible before killing a tri-life body of a divine Pseudo Invincible. Ultimately, the divine was killed off by Niu Baidao.

And now, Zhu Tiandao, the seemingly weak number two, had instantly killed a Pseudo Invincible from the nether race after revealing himself as a Pseudo Invincible as well. What about the third number two on the battlefield, Qin Hao?
Qin Hao, who was on the verge of being beaten to death, blanked out. Huh? Had the beating stopped? He looked at Zhu Tiandao in confusion. He also looked at Marquis Xia in confusion.
Of the three number twos, was he the only real eighth-stage Sunmoon?
Originally, Marquis Xia was supposed to be an eighth-stage Sunmoon while Zhu Tiandao was supposed to be an early ninth-stage Sunmoon.

But now, Marquis Xia had unleashed the combat strength of a Pseudo Invincible and killed the tri-life body of a Pseudo Invincible. Zhu Tiandao was even crazier as he had killed a Pseudo Invincible instantly.
Of the seventeen enemy Pseudo Invincibles, six had perished. The rest of them were finally starting to feel fear.
Was this a joke? Humanity wasn’t supposed to have even one Pseudo Invincible to spare here. That was why they had agreed on this endeavor.
But now…
The five elemental and primordial giant were feeling endless regret at getting involved in this mess.

Zhu Tiandao, Lan Tian, First Divine, Marquis Xia, Liu Wenyan, Niu Baidao…each of them was so strong it didn’t make any sense. Sure, they represented the combat strength of only six Pseudo Invincibles, but they seemed capable of surpassing even the numerically superior enemies they were facing.

Just look at how First Divine was handling three opponents all by himself even as Lan Tian was giving a dragon the beating of his life. If this continued, more of them would perish. And the rest of them seemed just as impressive.
After killing a Pseudo Invincible, Zhu Tiandao hollered, “First Divine, no, Yun Chen, keep those three busy. I’ll kill them all.”
The three Pseudo Invincibles were alarmed to hear that.
First Divine alone was already an extremely tricky opponent to deal with. Zhu Tiandao seemed even stronger. If the two were allowed to join hands, it was likely that all three of them would perish.
Desperate, the immortal Pseudo Invincible roared, “I beseech the immortal king to grace us with his presence!”
“Sigh.”

With a sigh, an ethereal expert appeared out of nowhere. He gazed at Zhu Tiandao and softly said, “Humanity…is indeed blessed by the heavens. Zhu Tiandao…what a surprise. Are you near dao affirmation?”
Zhu Tiandao was far stronger than he had any right to be.
One of his tri-life bodies was stored in the Hundred Dao Pagoda. It also felt like a second tri-life body was about to walk out of the River of Time.
